name: shopee_ads-mcp
description: Shopee Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a

platform_mcp_shopee_ads_partner_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_PARTNER_KEY
platform_mcp_shopee_ads_partner_key.description: partner_key (live key) of the Shopee Open Platform app with the Ads (AMS/Ads) API permission; signs the token refresh and every shop call (HMAC-SHA256). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_shopee_ads_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_shopee_ads_refresh_token.description: refresh_token from GetAccessToken (/api/v2/auth/token/get) after the shop authorised the app (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20). Valid 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

platform_mcp_shopee_ads_partner_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_PARTNER_ID
platform_mcp_shopee_ads_partner_id.description: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App).

platform_mcp_shopee_ads_shop_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_ADS_SHOP_ID
platform_mcp_shopee_ads_shop_id.description: shop_id of the authorised shop (returned in the authorisation redirect).

tools.name: me
tools.description: v2.ads.get_total_balance: the shop's real-time ads credit (response.total_balance, paid plus free credits, and data_timestamp).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: v2.ads.get_product_level_campaign_id_list (ad_type all, offset/limit; response.has_next_page): the shop's product campaign ids with ad_type auto|manual only — `name` carries that ad_type because the list returns no names. Names, campaign_status (ongoing, scheduled, ended, paused, deleted, closed), campaign_budget and duration come from v2.ads.get_product_level_campaign_setting_info (https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.ads.get_product_level_campaign_setting_info?module=127&type=1, up to 100 ids). account_id and status are not sent (the shop_id selects the shop).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: v2.ads.get_all_cpc_ads_daily_performance (start_date/end_date as DD-MM-YYYY): shop-level CPC ads performance per day — impression, clicks, ctr, expense, direct/broad orders, conversions, items sold and GMV, cost_per_conversion, direct_roas (all in raw). campaign_id is not applied: per-campaign days come from v2.ads.get_product_campaign_daily_performance (https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.ads.get_product_campaign_daily_performance?module=127&type=1).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: v2.ads.edit_manual_product_ads with edit_action change_budget sets the campaign budget (campaign_budget in the shop currency; 0 = unlimited) of a manual-selection product campaign; auto product ads use v2.ads.edit_auto_product_ads, which is 'coming offline soon'. This spends money. currency is ignored (the shop's currency applies).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: v2.ads.edit_manual_product_ads with edit_action pause | resume (other actions: start, stop, delete, change_budget, change_duration, …) for a manual-selection product campaign. Resuming restarts spend.
